text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mixed reactions greet political party registration.
- Federal Office of Statistics and central bank begin work on projects aimed at reducing the problems of data lags as well as inconsistency in published data.
- Calabar Export Processing Zone says government should pay it more attention because of its role in development.
- Six merchant banks are bidding for the mandate to package a one billion naira refinancing plan for Savannah Bank as the central bank screens its new directors.

- Fishing trawler owners say catches are likely to fall, as only 250 out of 400 trawlers are in operation. Fishermen blamed difficult import procedures and the high cost of spare parts for the dilapidated state of the fleet.
- The Presidency is considering a proposal for the central bank and Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation to take over the distressed Allied Bank.
- Meteorological Services Department gets new computer systems to provide more timely and accurate weather forecasts.
